baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated construction joins yattakhidha at word 5 to walad at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acquisition branch of taking-for-oneself meets offspring and derivation: the ayah excludes both biological begetting and the appropriation of a derivative being into God's own filial possession.

activation_trace.role: Taking or making something for oneself supplies the possessive operation that the negation blocks.
Offspring from lineage supplies the relational object refused to that possessive operation.
A thing arising from another sharpens the denial of derivative divine being.

changed_reading.before: God does not have a child.
changed_reading.after: No offspring can arise from God and then be taken into divine possession or lineage; the rejected model is both generative and appropriative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root k-w-n spans ma kana at word 2 and kun fa-yakunu at words 15-16 around qada amran and yaqulu.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root first marks filial acquisition as an inadmissible mode of being, then marks the commanded matter's presence. Decisive making, a matter, utterance, and occurrence form a compact causal chain.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence bind the opening impossibility to the closing command and result.
Executed and perfected making supplies the effective determination behind the sequence.
The matter or affair supplies the determinate object of decree and address.
Articulated saying supplies the mediating act between determination and presence.

changed_reading.before: A denial of sonship is followed by a generic formula of omnipotence.
changed_reading.after: The ayah internally reverses k-w-n: filial acquisition cannot be, whereas a decreed matter comes to be through direct address.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Subhanahu at word 8 stands between the negated filial model and the positive decree-speech-being account.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exoneration branch functions as an argumentative hinge: it clears the rejected category before the ayah states a different mode of causation.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and distancing from defect supply the categorical clearance at the verse's center.
Acquisition for oneself names the model cleared away.
Effective making names the positive causal model introduced after the clearance.

changed_reading.before: Subhanahu is a parenthetical praise between two claims.
changed_reading.after: Subhanahu is the logical boundary that removes acquisitive generation before decree and command explain coming-to-be.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnancy, labor, birth, and living embodiment unfold in ordered time around the focus. This revises command-to-being from necessarily instantaneous appearance to immediate causal dependence whose effect can traverse a creaturely process.

activation_trace.role: Effective determination supplies the initiating causal act.
Coming into presence supplies the result whose temporal shape is being tested.
Hidden pregnancy supplies an extended embodied stage between promise and visible child.
Labor's bodily disturbance supplies a second processual stage.
The event of birth supplies the narrated emergence from pregnancy.
Embodied life supplies the state reached and later restored.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence 19:20-33 moves from an impossibility question through pregnancy, labor, birth, life, death, and raising.
The focus's idha and fa-links assert causal entailment, while the surrounding narrative displays elapsed stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decree, command, and a narrated bodily sequence; I infer a distinction between immediate causal sufficiency and temporal manifestation. A live alternative is that kun fa-yakunu denotes punctiliar appearance and the gestational sequence is only downstream narration.

changed_reading.before: Kun fa-yakunu means that the whole created event must appear without process or duration.
changed_reading.after: Kun fa-yakunu marks unmediated dependence on divine decision, while the commanded being may still unfold through pregnancy, labor, birth, and life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative distributes agency across contrasting verbs: Mary takes a barrier for herself, the boy is given to her, and God makes him a sign. The focus then denies that God occupies the recipient-parent role by taking a child for himself.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the denied divine role.
Offspring supplies the object whose possessive reclassification is refused.
Mary's ordinary taking-for-herself concretizes the acquisition verb before its negated divine use.
Gift without return places Mary, not God, in the recipient relation to the child.
Making the child into a sign assigns God transformative agency rather than filial acquisition.

structural_cues: Mary takes a veil in 19:17, receives the announced boy in 19:19, and the child is made a sign in 19:21.
The focus repeats the taking verb but negates its application to God and walad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated acquisition verb and separate gift/making verbs; I infer deliberate role distribution between giver, recipient, and created sign. A live alternative is that the repeated verbs are locally independent and only the explicit negation matters.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely denies that God selected or adopted a child.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes divine giving and making from taking-for-self: God originates the sign but is not its recipient-parent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Touch, pregnancy, labor, father, mother, and birth accumulate into a complete human reproductive and kinship system. The focus's walad is therefore not an isolated title but the endpoint of a material-social chain categorically bounded away from God.

activation_trace.role: Lineal offspring anchors the focus claim to the human kinship category.
Sexual contact supplies the normally expected initiating mechanism that Mary explicitly lacks.
Pregnancy supplies hidden bodily generation.
Labor supplies the transition from gestation to delivery.
Fatherhood supplies one social pole of ordinary lineage.
The mother as bearer and nurturer supplies the other social pole.
The explicit mother-by-birth relation attaches Jesus to Mary.
Birth as an event completes the narrated human chain.

structural_cues: Mary's no-touch question precedes pregnancy and labor; the crowd then invokes father and mother; Jesus names his mother and day of birth.
The focus follows this dense chain immediately after identifying Jesus as son of Mary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every major bodily and social link of human generation; I infer that their accumulation defines the category excluded from God. A live alternative is that these details defend Mary's chastity without contributing to the scope of 19:35.

changed_reading.before: Walad is an abstract theological label denied of God.
changed_reading.after: Walad condenses the whole touch-pregnancy-birth-parentage system; the denial bars transferring that creaturely chain to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context does not erase Jesus' relations; it sorts them. Sonship and origin point to Mary, while servitude, worship, ownership, and lordship orient Jesus and everyone else toward God.

activation_trace.role: Offspring anchors the divine relation being denied.
Sonship and attribution to an origin attach Jesus' filial designation explicitly to Mary.
Servitude under ownership supplies Jesus' declared relation to God.
Shared lordship over speaker and audience supplies the governing relation to God.
Worshipful obedience supplies the response appropriate to that lordship.

structural_cues: 19:34 says Jesus son of Mary directly before the focus denial.
19:30 calls him servant of God, and 19:36 calls God my Lord and your Lord and commands worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent but different relational predicates; I infer that 19:35 polices their allocation rather than negating Jesus' created origin or human sonship. A live alternative is that each title stands independently without forming a deliberate relational taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: The denial removes a title from God without specifying the positive relation.
changed_reading.after: The passage reallocates relations: Jesus is son with respect to Mary, but servant and worshipper under the Lord shared by all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scene moves through restrained speech, gesture, intelligible infant speech, and finally divine address whose addressee becomes. Speech is graded by efficacy, making yaqulu a functional climax rather than ornamental anthropomorphism.

activation_trace.role: Articulated saying supplies the final and maximally effective speech act.
Presence supplies the direct result joined to divine address.
Restraint of the tongue establishes deliberate human non-speech.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors names what Mary withholds.
Manual indication substitutes a visible sign for Mary's words.
The infant's articulated declaration reveals identity when ordinary speech was judged impossible.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from Mary's vow not to speak, through her pointing, to the infant's declaration and the focus's divine saying.
Qawl recurs at 19:34 as the truth formula immediately before divine yaqulu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of silence, sign, creaturely declaration, and divine address; I infer an escalation of semiotic efficacy. A live alternative is that these are narrative speech events with no intended scale culminating in creation.

changed_reading.before: Yaqulu simply clothes divine power in the familiar image of speech.
changed_reading.after: Yaqulu caps a speech-and-sign sequence: creaturely words disclose identity, while divine address joins signification directly to being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The q-d-y plus amr formula frames the focus on both sides: the child's affair is already decreed, and the Day of Regret arrives when the affair is finally decided. The focus's creative decree thus belongs to a larger arc of irreversible origination and closure.

activation_trace.role: Effective making supplies the focus formula's originating force.
The matter supplies what decree determines.
A cutting, settled judgment marks the announced child's affair as already determined.
The child's affair supplies the prenatal instance of the formula.
Final adjudicative closure supplies the terminal instance of the same formula.
The affair now appears as the matter conclusively settled at judgment.
Regret over what has escaped supplies the affective consequence of irreversible closure.

structural_cues: 19:21 has amran maqdiyyan, 19:35 has qada amran, and 19:39 has qudiya al-amr.
The three formulas move from announced birth, through a general causal rule, to eschatological finality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight lexical frame around the focus; I infer that creative execution and judicial closure are two directions of decisive qada. A live alternative is formulaic repetition without a designed origin-to-end arc.

changed_reading.before: Qada amran in the focus refers only to initiating a created thing.
changed_reading.after: The focus sits inside a decree arc: the same decisiveness originates the commanded being and closes history beyond recall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated withdrawal, barrier, and distance give a material analogy for subhanahu: at the focus it performs conceptual separation, preventing the embodied story from being projected back as divine biology.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and distancing supply the focus's conceptual separation.
Mary's withdrawal to one side supplies the first spatial separation image.
A screening barrier supplies a boundary that blocks category-crossing access.
Repeated withdrawal with the pregnancy reinforces separation around the embodied event.
The distant side supplies maximal spatial removal as an analogy for categorical distance.

structural_cues: The narrative opens with withdrawal and a veil, then repeats withdrawal to a distant place.
Subhanahu occupies the exact pivot between rejected son-taking and the positive account of decree.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated spatial boundaries and a focus exoneration; I map physical separation onto the argument's conceptual boundary. A live alternative is that the spatial sequence belongs only to Mary's privacy and subhanahu remains a devotional interjection.

changed_reading.before: Subhanahu expresses general reverence after denying a child.
changed_reading.after: Subhanahu actively seals the category boundary: the story's embodied mechanisms cannot be transferred to the divine mode of causing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it brings inheritance logic into a sonship denial. It remains anchored in yattakhidha min walad and the window's closing claim that God inherits the earth; render it as an exploratory dynastic echo, not as the lexical definition of walad.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies taking offspring for oneself, while 19:40 closes by assigning final inheritance to God.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the denied possessive act.
Offspring supplies the possible vehicle of lineage and succession.
Inheritance from a predecessor supplies the dynastic frame that the divine claim reverses.
Possession transferred without contract or effort casts God as final recipient of all possession, not a predecessor needing an heir.

changed_reading.before: The denial concerns biological or adoptive sonship alone.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also denies dynastic need: God takes no heir for continuity because all possession returns to God as final inheritor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's split q-w-l mapping to q-l-l and must not be stated as an etymology of yaqulu. It remains anchored in the focus saying and the context's repeated carrying; render it only as an imagistic resonance of command setting a matter into manifest motion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yaqulu at word 13 resolves in the packet not only to q-w-l branches but also to a q-l-l branch of carrying and rising.

activation_trace.role: Taking up a load and rising supplies a form-distant image of the decree being set into effective motion.
Pregnancy as inward carrying gives the command's result a hidden embodied vehicle.
Visible carrying of the child supplies the manifested endpoint of what was first borne inwardly.

changed_reading.before: Divine saying is only a vocal image placed before the result.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, saying also images taking up the decreed matter and carrying it from hidden determination into manifest presence.

strongest_changes: The repeated k-w-n turns an impossible filial mode of being into the proper command-to-presence mode.
Pregnancy, labor, and birth separate immediate divine causality from necessarily instantaneous creaturely manifestation.
Gift, making, servitude, and lordship redistribute roles so that God originates the sign without becoming its recipient-parent.
The q-d-y plus amr frame links the child's prior decree, the focus's causal rule, and eschatological closure.
summary.what_was_special: The surrounding ayat supply an unusually complete bodily, social, verbal, and temporal production system around a very compact focus. That density changes 19:35 from an isolated denial into a categorical correction of causation and relation while preserving multiple live readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether fa-yakunu signals temporal immediacy or causal certainty compatible with process.
Whether the three decree formulas intentionally fuse creation and judgment or simply reuse an idiom.
Whether the inheritance and q-w-l to q-l-l resonances merit downstream prose beyond their contained outlier status.
